message: You're importing a component that needs useState in Server Component
stack_trace_snippet: Error: You're importing a component that needs useState. It only works in a Client Component but none of its parents are marked with use client
root_cause: HospitalNavbar.tsx lacked the 'use client' directive at line 1, causing Next.js App Router to treat it as a Server Component where client hooks (useState, usePathname) are disallowed
fix_applied: Prepended 'use client'; to line 1 of src/components/layout/HospitalNavbar.tsx

stack_trace_snippet: Cannot find module ./276.js at webpack-runtime.js at .next/server/app/_not-found/page.js
root_cause: Trinh duyet luu Service Worker cu tu du an khac tren localhost:3000 yeu cau /sw.js khong ton tai; ket hop voi webpack cache .next bi loi chunk sau khi chay npm run build trong luc dev server dang mo dan den not-found rot vao 500 Cannot find module
fix_applied: 1. Tao public/sw.js xu ly lifecycle tu dong unregister va xoa cache ton du cua trinh duyet; 2. Tao src/app/not-found.tsx render 404 chuan thay vi fall-back chunk loi; 3. Khoi dong lai dev server Next.js.

root_cause: Tien trinh npm run dev duoc bat tu 11:27 sang van dang chay ngam tren port 3000 khi npm run build (next build) duoc thuc thi luc 16:37. next build da ghi de toan bo thu muc .next/ thanh production artifacts, khien dev server bi desync, khong tim thay cac dev chunks fallback/webpack.js, react-refresh.js va tra ve 500.
fix_applied: 1) Terminate tat ca cac process next dev cu bi ket (PID 18116, 21764, 21812); 2) Xoa sach cache .next/ bi conflict; 3) Khoi dong lai dev server moi, compile 200 OK.
